title: Crab holding a balloon
svg:

  <ellipse cx='44' cy='63' rx='17' ry='10' fill='#ffa04d'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='61' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#ffd08a'/>

  <path d='M56 58 Q64 50 60 42' stroke='#ff7a1a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 42 L66 38 L63 45 Z' fill='#ff7a1a'/>

  <ellipse cx='34' cy='44' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3a1200'/>

  <circle cx='46.8' cy='42.8' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M34 51 Q40 56 46 51' stroke='#3a1200' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='29' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ff9fb0'/>
